question: What is the primary advantage of biochemical assessment over anthropometric measurements in nutrition?

options.A: Costs significantly less than standard clinical examinations
options.B: Provides an accurate estimate of lifetime dietary intake
options.C: Requires no specialized laboratory equipment or personnel
options.D: Detects subclinical deficiencies before physical signs appear

explanation: Biochemical markers measure nutrient levels directly in tissues or fluids, revealing imbalances at an early cellular stage before physical symptoms manifest. [learn more](GNS227_U5_T005#GNS227_U5_T005_h1)

question: Why must laboratory data always be evaluated alongside a patient's clinical history?

options.A: Dietary surveys are legally required before a diagnosis can be finalized
options.B: Laboratory equipment in regional hospitals is frequently uncalibrated
options.C: Nutritional biomarkers can be influenced by non-nutritional factors like inflammation
options.D: Biochemical tests only measure water-soluble vitamin concentrations

explanation: Many biochemical markers are non-specific and fluctuate due to acute-phase responses, infection, or hydration status rather than pure dietary intake. [learn more](GNS227_U5_T005#GNS227_U5_T005_h1)

question: Which visceral protein has the shortest half-life, making it most sensitive to acute changes in nutritional status?
explanation: Prealbumin has a half-life of two to three days, allowing it to respond rapidly to fluctuations in dietary protein and energy intake. [learn more](GNS227_U5_T005#GNS227_U5_T005_h2)

question: A patient with iron deficiency anemia is evaluated for nutritional status. Which visceral protein measurement will be falsely elevated by this concurrent condition?
explanation: Transferrin synthesis increases when iron stores are low to maximize transport capacity, meaning iron deficiency artificially elevates serum transferrin levels. [learn more](GNS227_U5_T005#GNS227_U5_T005_h2)

question: What is a major limitation of using serum assays to evaluate micronutrient status?

options.A: Homeostatic mechanisms can maintain normal serum levels despite tissue depletion
options.B: Blood samples degrade within minutes at room temperature
options.C: Micronutrients do not circulate freely in the bloodstream
options.D: Laboratory assays for vitamins are completely automated and error-free

explanation: The body often pulls micronutrients from organ stores to keep blood concentrations stable, meaning serum tests can miss early intracellular deficits. [learn more](GNS227_U5_T005#GNS227_U5_T005_h3)

question: Why is a serum vitamin A level difficult to interpret in a child with an active acute infection?

options.A: Fever rapidly destroys circulating fat-soluble vitamins in the bloodstream
options.B: Antibiotics immediately bind to vitamin A and cause precipitation
options.C: Infections suppress the transport proteins required to carry vitamin A in the blood
options.D: Bacterial pathogens consume all available vitamin A for cell wall synthesis

explanation: Vitamin A travels bound to retinol-binding protein, which acts as a negative acute-phase reactant and drops during inflammatory states. [learn more](GNS227_U5_T005#GNS227_U5_T005_h3)

question: Which red blood cell index specifically measures the average size of circulating erythrocytes?
explanation: Mean Corpuscular Volume classifies anemias based on cell size, categorizing them as microcytic, normocytic, or macrocytic. [learn more](GNS227_U5_T005#GNS227_U5_T005_h4)

question: A patient presents with fatigue and laboratory results showing an elevated MCV (macrocytic). Which nutritional deficiency is most likely responsible?
explanation: Deficiencies in vitamin B12 or folate disrupt DNA synthesis in red blood cell precursors, leading to abnormally large erythrocytes known as megalocytes. [learn more](GNS227_U5_T005#GNS227_U5_T005_h4)

question: What is the primary effect of systemic inflammation on serum albumin concentrations?

options.A: Albumin levels remain completely unchanged regardless of inflammation
options.B: Albumin levels decrease because it is a negative acute-phase reactant
options.C: Albumin levels increase to fight off invading pathogens
options.D: Albumin binds directly to CRP and precipitates out of the blood

explanation: The liver downregulates the synthesis of albumin during inflammatory responses, prioritizing the production of immune defense proteins instead. [learn more](GNS227_U5_T005#GNS227_U5_T005_h5)

question: Why should C-reactive protein (CRP) be measured alongside serum prealbumin in a hospitalized patient?

options.A: To measure the circulating iron-binding capacity of plasma proteins
options.B: To calculate the exact caloric requirements needed for weight gain
options.C: To determine if low prealbumin is caused by inflammation rather than poor nutrition
options.D: To confirm the presence of a primary bacterial urinary tract infection

explanation: Checking CRP helps clinicians distinguish whether depressed visceral protein levels stem from inadequate nutrition or an active inflammatory response. [learn more](GNS227_U5_T005#GNS227_U5_T005_h5)

question: How does severe fluid overload (overhydration) typically affect laboratory nutritional test results?

options.A: It hemoconcentrates blood components, causing falsely high readings
options.B: It selectively destroys water-soluble vitamins in the plasma
options.C: It has no measurable effect on circulating blood proteins or electrolytes
options.D: It hemodilutes blood components, causing falsely low concentration readings

explanation: Excess fluid expands plasma volume, diluting circulating proteins and nutrients so that laboratory values appear lower than actual tissue stores. [learn more](GNS227_U5_T005#GNS227_U5_T005_h6)

question: Which clinical condition must be considered when interpreting elevated serum creatinine alongside nutritional lab markers?
explanation: Kidney dysfunction alters the filtration and excretion of metabolic waste and proteins, distorting standard biochemical evaluations. [learn more](GNS227_U5_T005#GNS227_U5_T005_h6)
